selection_rule: Choose the smallest exact Pareto feature-set option whose overall repeated-CV mean Macro-F1 95% confidence-interval upper bound is greater than or equal to the one-standard-error performance threshold: best-option overall mean minus the best option's standard error. Resolve equal-size ties by higher overall repeated-CV mean Macro-F1, then longer exact recurrence, then earlier representative iteration.
uncertainty_unit: standard error of the overall repeated-CV mean, calculated from the repeat-level means; each repeat-level mean averages the five fold-level Macro-F1 values
